en: Colorized vintage view of a landscaped pond and park with a tree-lined shore, small boats at the water's edge, walking paths, and benches. On the left is a building covered in ivy with two pointed turret-like towers and an outdoor café terrace furnished with many white chairs. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. At the top left, printed text reads "GRAZ Hilmteich."
